title: Add a heartbeat and the producer fallback to the alert contract
goal: The contract says how a producer learns that NERV has stopped acknowledging, and what it does then
acceptance: [SOLUTION, "Alert contract"](docs/SOLUTION.md#alert-contract) gains a heartbeat: what the producer can observe about the consumer (the last time its snapshot was read, or an explicit acknowledgement), its interval, and what counts as "NERV has not acknowledged for N minutes" with N stated and justified

The fallback is written per producer table: what grover and fpvbuddy do when N minutes pass without an acknowledgement (their own owner notice path, quiet-hour rules, how often, and the clear when acknowledgement returns); a producer never silently drops an alert it could not hand over
The change is additive under "Versioning" (no new major) or a new major is written first with its coordination record; the JSON Schema and the producer mapping rows are updated
Evidence from report C3 and X1: nothing outside NERV tells the owner NERV is down; the standby bases see missed Kaji heartbeats but send no owner notice (nerv proposal 1 owns that side)
Failing test committed first: if the schema changes, a fixture of the new field that the current schema rejects; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 2 h for the coordinator side: one contract section, two producer rows and the schema. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
